title: 模型能力增强的数据与评估闭环
summary: 提出“能力切片”概念，将评估样本按背景条件、任务类型、求解操作和输出约束分组，构建评估分类法、非指令数据分类法和映射规则，形成闭环，将基准级失败转化为可测试的数据干预。两个案例验证：一个排除数据问题（恢复掩码损失），另一个定位数学推理弱点并针对性采样，显著提升AIME成绩。
summary_en: Proposes the 'capability slice' concept to group evaluation samples by background condition, task type, solving operation, and output constraint, building a closed loop with evaluation taxonomy, non-instruction data taxonomy, and mapping rules to turn benchmark-level failures into targeted data interventions. Two case studies validate: one rules out data issues (restoring masked loss), the other localizes math reasoning weaknesses and improves AIME scores significantly.
